config.label: Client ID from your Clio developer application (Settings → Developer Applications)
config.description: Client ID from your Clio developer application (Settings → Developer Applications)

config.label: Client Secret from your Clio developer application
config.description: Client Secret from your Clio developer application

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Leave unset to auto-generate a key stored in the OS keychain (or ~/.clio-mcp/key.hex as fallback on headless Linux/WSL2). If set, must be a 64-character hex string — it will be migrated to the OS keychain on first use.

config.label: Local port for the OAuth callback listener (default: 5678)
config.description: Local port for the OAuth callback listener (default: 5678). Change if 5678 is in use.

config.label: Clio data region: 'us' (default, app
config.description: Clio data region: 'us' (default, app.clio.com), 'eu' (eu.app.clio.com), 'au' (au.app.clio.com), or 'ca' (ca.app.clio.com). Controls the API and OAuth base URLs. Fixed at Clio account creation; must match the server your firm logs in to. Any other value stops startup.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. 'true', '1' or 'yes' leaves the nine write tools (create_matter, create_note, create_task, update_task, complete_task, create_calendar_entry, log_time_entry, create_activity, upload_document) unregistered so Claude can read Clio but never change it. Works on both transports.

config.label: Advanced override for the Clio API base URL (e
config.description: Advanced override for the Clio API base URL (e.g. https://eu.app.clio.com/api/v4). Takes precedence over CLIO_REGION.

config.label: Override the OAuth authorization endpoint (e
config.description: Override the OAuth authorization endpoint (e.g. https://eu.app.clio.com/oauth/authorize).

config.label: Override the OAuth token endpoint (e
config.description: Override the OAuth token endpoint (e.g. https://eu.app.clio.com/oauth/token).
